research_question: Does the heading Formography improve practitioner comprehension or reduce explanation burden for the same governed mapping method compared with Governed Property Graph?

design.assignment: within-participant label assignment with paired complementary schedules
design.case_order: balanced so every case appears four times in each position
design.blinding: the method body and case text are identical under both labels

critical_misunderstandings: treating a projection as the authority
treating one factorization as universally correct

formography_promotion_gate.comprehension: not lower than Governed Property Graph
formography_promotion_gate.median_completion_time: at least 10 percent lower than Governed Property Graph
formography_promotion_gate.corrections: not higher than Governed Property Graph
formography_promotion_gate.terminology_preference: at least two thirds of participants prefer Formography
formography_promotion_gate.critical_misunderstanding_rate: no greater than 20 percent for Formography
